question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE year_range AS (
    SELECT 1800 as year_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year_num + 1 FROM year_range WHERE year_num < 2100
),
male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide, l.first_name, l.last_name, MIN(lt.term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide, l.first_name, l.last_name
),
legislator_years AS (
    SELECT 
        ml.id_bioguide,
        ml.first_term_start,
        lt.term_start,
        lt.term_end,
        lt.state
    FROM male_la_legislators ml
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON ml.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
),
year_checks AS (
    SELECT 
        ly.id_bioguide,
        ly.first_term_start,
        ly.term_start,
        ly.term_end,
        ly.state,
        yr.year_num,
        CAST(yr.year_num || '-12-31' AS DATE) as dec31_date,
        yr.year_num - year(CAST(ly.first_term_start AS DATE)) as years_elapsed,
        CASE WHEN CAST(ly.term_start AS DATE) <= CAST(yr.year_num || '-12-31' AS DATE) AND CAST(ly.term_end AS DATE) > CAST(yr.year_num || '-12-31' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_serving
    FROM legislator_years ly
    JOIN year_range yr ON yr.year_num >= year(CAST(ly.first_term_start AS DATE)) AND yr.year_num <= year(CAST(ly.term_end AS DATE)) + 1
)
SELECT 
    years_elapsed,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as distinct_legislators
FROM year_checks
WHERE years_elapsed > 30 AND years_elapsed < 50 AND is_serving = 1
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed

WITH male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide, l.first_name, l.last_name, MIN(lt.term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide, l.first_name, l.last_name
